name: Conflict-rich theater
mission: Assess near-term conflict intensity and escalation risk along the contested frontier.

hypotheses.text: Fighting is intensifying with a broader offensive underway.
Activity remains a localized protracted stalemate with flares.
External diplomatic pressure is producing de-escalation.

events.title: Artillery exchange intensifies near eastern sector
events.summary: Heavy shelling reported overnight with multiple civilian infrastructure hits.

events.title: Drone strike reported on logistics node
events.summary: Unconfirmed initial reports of UAV attack on a rail junction used for military supply.

events.title: Troop movements observed toward contact line
events.summary: Open-source imagery analysts note convoy activity consistent with reinforcement.

events.title: Officials deny imminent large-scale offensive
events.summary: Statement frames recent fighting as localized and rejects escalation narrative.

events.title: Cross-border strike claims circulate
events.summary: Conflicting toll figures between 3 and 11 killed within hours.

events.title: Clashes continue for third consecutive day
events.summary: Battle-related events remain elevated versus the prior week.

events.title: No new ceasefire talks scheduled
events.summary: Diplomatic calendar empty for the coming fortnight according to envoys.

events.title: Displacement rises from frontline towns
events.summary: Local authorities report several thousand newly displaced overnight.

anomalySeries.note: Elevated vs baseline — instrument should flag upward surge
